theory.title: Futuro continuo y futuro perfecto para planificar
theory.explanation: Usa el futuro continuo (will be + -ing) para una acción que estará en curso en un momento futuro. Usa el futuro perfecto (will have + participio) para algo que estará terminado antes de un momento futuro. Compara: At 10, I'll be meeting the supplier (a las diez estaré reuniéndome con el proveedor); by 10, I'll have sent the invoice (para las diez habré enviado la factura).
theory.tip: At + hora futura: acción en curso (will be -ing). By + momento futuro: acción completada (will have + participio).

By the end of the month, I'll have saved enough.
→ Para finales de mes, habré ahorrado lo suficiente.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo y futuro perfecto para planificar · 7
patterns.pattern: At noon, they will be discussing the new budget.
examples:
At noon, they will be discussing the new budget.
→ Al mediodía estarán hablando del nuevo presupuesto.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo y futuro perfecto para planificar · 8
patterns.pattern: The company will have opened the new store by June.
examples:
The company will have opened the new store by June.
→ La empresa habrá abierto la nueva tienda para junio.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo y futuro perfecto para planificar · 9
patterns.pattern: At this time next year, she will be managing the team.
examples:
At this time next year, she will be managing the team.
→ Por estas fechas el año que viene, ella estará dirigiendo el equipo.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo y futuro perfecto para planificar · 10
patterns.pattern: By next summer, we will have paid off the loan.
examples:
By next summer, we will have paid off the loan.
→ Para el próximo verano, habremos terminado de pagar el préstamo.

items.prompt: Describe what you will be doing at this time tomorrow.

Planning purchases helps me manage my budget and avoid unnecessary expenses.

content.audioTranscript: A: I'm calling about my order. B: Do you have the receipt? A: Yes. The customer service told me I could get a refund. B: Was there a problem with the delivery? A: Yes, so I asked to speak to the manager. B: I'll contact the supplier and check the payment. A: Thank you. Is the parcel going to the right address? B: Yes, it should arrive tomorrow.
